title: Global Well-posedness and Asymptotic Analysis of a Damped Nonlinear Wave Equation with a Codimension-One Constraint
summary: We prove the global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to a constrained version of the damped nonlinear wave equation $$ \vartheta_{tt}+γ\vartheta_t-Δ\vartheta+|\vartheta|^{p-2}\vartheta=0 $$ on a smooth bounded domain $\varOmega\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, where the evolution is projected onto the tangent space of the Hilbert manifold $$\mathcal{M} = \left\{ \vartheta\in L^2(\varOmega):\|\vartheta\|_{L^2(\varOmega)}=1 \right\}, $$ which is the unit sphere in $L^2(\varOmega)$.
